data.name: MenuQuitNote
data.value: Quits the window and the menu bar icon. The service goes on with the tasks; the icon comes back at the next login.

data.name: DemoUsb
data.value: The disk BACKUP-USB is not connected.

data.name: DemoLocked
data.value: the file changed while it was read, taken from the snapshot: Reports/2026-11 budget.xlsx

data.name: CloudKept
data.value: Destinations on {0} are set up in CUSTOS for Windows or on the monitoring site. The task keeps this destination as it is.

data.name: NetworkPathNote
data.value: //server/share/folder, as in Finder «smb://server/share/folder». CUSTOS connects the share itself for the run and disconnects it afterwards.

data.name: NetworkAccountNote
data.value: The account of the server (NAS) the share is on. Without one, the share must allow guests.

data.name: DestinationUsbHelp
data.value: The name of the disk as Finder shows it (its folder in /Volumes). The copy waits if the disk is not connected.

data.name: DestinationUsbFolderHelp
data.value: The folder inside the disk, from its root: /CUSTOS/Documents.

data.name: DestinationLocalHelp
data.value: A folder from the root: /Users/Shared/Backup. Another disk is a folder in /Volumes, but an external disk is better set as «External disk».

data.name: ThemeHelp
data.value: «As in macOS» follows System Settings → Appearance.

data.name: ColorHelp
data.value: Only for you: other users of this Mac keep their own. It changes at once.

data.name: SevenZipVersion
data.value: 7-Zip {0} comes inside the program and is updated with it.

data.name: SettingsAccountsNote
data.value: Logins of network folders, servers and storages. The passwords are kept by the service in the system keychain of this Mac.

data.name: AllowAllUsersEditHelp
data.value: Administrators of this Mac may always change tasks and settings. With this box, every user who logs in may.

data.name: AccountDomainNote
data.value: Only for a Windows domain; empty for a NAS.

data.name: AccountPasswordNote
data.value: Kept by the service in the system keychain; never shown again.

data.name: UpdateAsk
data.value: Install CUSTOS {0}? The service restarts for a minute; a run in progress is stopped and continued after the update.

data.name: SourceRemoteKept
data.value: Linux servers are set up in CUSTOS for Windows or on the monitoring site; the task keeps them as they are.

data.name: DatabasesKept
data.value: Database servers ({0}) are set up in CUSTOS for Windows or on the monitoring site; the task keeps them as they are.

data.name: SourcesNote
data.value: The service reads the files as root. For the folders of users (Desktop, Documents, Mail) macOS needs Full Disk Access for CUSTOS: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access.

data.name: FilterIncludeNote
data.value: Masks separated by «;»: *.docx; *.xlsx. Empty = all files.

data.name: FilterExcludeDirsNote
data.value: One per line: a name (node_modules) or a path inside a source (Library/Caches).

data.name: FilterSkipHidden
data.value: Skip hidden files (names starting with a dot)

data.name: ErrorNotNetwork
data.value: «{0}» is not a network path: it must look like //server/share.

data.name: ErrorPathNotAbsolute
data.value: «{0}» must be a full path from the root, like /Users/Shared/Documents.

data.name: ScheduleMonthDaysNote
data.value: Days separated by commas: 1, 15, last. A day the month does not have (31 in April) runs on its last day.

data.name: ArchiveZipHelp
data.value: Opens in Finder and on Windows without extra programs.

data.name: EventsNote
data.value: Programs and scripts run as root, before and after the copy. A .sh script runs through the shell even without the executable bit.

data.name: AfterNote
data.value: Only after a run that was started by the schedule.

data.name: EventProgramHelp
data.value: A program or a script, a full path from the root.

data.name: EventServiceHelp
data.value: The label of the service as launchctl list shows it: com.example.database, homebrew.mxcl.mysql.

data.name: SnapshotEnabled
data.value: Read the files from an APFS snapshot

data.name: SnapshotHelp
data.value: Before the copy, a snapshot of the startup disk is taken (as Time Machine does), so files that change meanwhile are copied whole and consistent. The snapshot is deleted after the run.

data.name: KeepPermissions
data.value: Keep the owner and the permissions of files

data.name: KeepPermissionsHelp
data.value: For copies without compression: files and folders in the copy get the owner and the permissions of the originals. If a destination does not take them (some network folders), the files are still copied and the run gets a warning.

data.name: ServiceLanguageHelp
data.value: The language of the run logs and of the messages of the service. «Automatic» follows the language of macOS. The window itself follows the language of the user.

data.name: ProgramPasswordHelp
data.value: When it is set, changing tasks and settings and restoring need it as well as the rights. Once typed, it is not asked again for 30 minutes after the last change, or until the window is closed. It can also be set or removed on the monitoring site. It guards against changes by mistake or by a passer-by, not against an administrator of this Mac.

data.name: CheckUpdatesHelp
data.value: The service asks github.com/{0} once a day. A new version appears in the program window and in the menu bar; it is installed only when an administrator presses «Update». The package is checked against the SHA-256 of the release.
